title: Kordylewski clouds as possible conscious plasma entities

tellings.quote: There are two of them as I recall at the L5 point. They are approximately nine times as large as the Earth itself.

plain: Out at the L5 point, a spot in space where the pull of Earth and Moon balance so things can collect, there are two faint clouds called Kordylewski clouds, each roughly nine times as large as Earth, and they may be conscious beings made of plasma, a charged gas. The parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove tells this from the writer Robert Temple's book A New Science of Heaven. If true, there would be living minds of enormous size close to our planet.
